definitions.explanation: A negative evaluation or unfavorable public opinion about a person, product, or policy. Can refer to specific critical reviews or a general reputation for being poor.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悪評|あくひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: That movie has many bad reviews.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{悪評|あくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: The new policy earned a bad reputation among citizens.

examples.japanese: {悪評|あくひょう}にもかかわらず、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいる→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: Despite the bad reviews, that shop is always crowded.

notes:
A negative evaluation or unfavorable reputation. Composed of {悪|あく} (bad) + {評|ひょう} (review/reputation). Can refer to both a bad review of a specific thing (film, product) and a general bad reputation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪評|あくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to earn a bad reputation
- {悪評|あくひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to get a bad name
- {悪評|あくひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まる→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧: for a bad reputation to spread
- {悪評|あくひょう}⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: notorious, infamous

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{好評|こうひょう}→好評：16720_kouhyou⟧: good reputation/favorable review — the direct opposite
- ⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧: reputation/reviews — neutral term that can be good or bad
- ⟦{不評|ふひょう}→不評：18302_fuhyou⟧: unpopularity/poor reception — similar but emphasizes lack of popularity rather than active negative criticism
